Box structure v2: coarse system topology

One solve over the whole box (h 8, min member 18 mm, 3000 cm³ generated, about 10.44 kg PETG, E), 14 load cases, 78 iterations. Blue = density 0.5 surface; orange = the catch; grey = the receivers. 1500 cm³ left 5 bays and 6 seat posts unjoined, so 3000 cm³ is the record.

Round 1. The sheets were modelled as 8 mm PETG held rigid at their bottom edge, so they carry much of the box (floor contact 12 cm²). Real sheets are 3 mm acrylic. Round 2 reruns on the final layout with the sheets as cladding before any piece is cut.
